meta.scope: Taiwan (Republic of China) Batch 1 — Foundational statistical system under locked definition. Statistics Act, DGBAS institutional role, core demographic, price, labour, national accounts, external and industrial series. Mirrors the opening structure used for Japan and South Korea.
meta.strategy_note: Taiwan continues the high-income East Asian sequence. Unique features (cross-strait dimension, semiconductor concentration, distinct international-agreement profile) will be developed in later batches. Definition remains frozen.

candidates.title: Statistics Act (統計法)
candidates.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS), Executive Yuan
candidates.description: Fundamental law governing the production, quality, objectivity and independence of government statistics in Taiwan. Defines the scope of official statistics, the role of BAS agencies, and the framework for basic national censuses and surveys.
referenced_by: All subsequent DGBAS statistical methodologies and quality frameworks
Official descriptions of the R.O.C. government statistical system
candidates.notes: Foundational recurring-citation node, parallel to Japan’s Statistics Act and Korea’s Statistics Act. Explicitly aims to ‘ensure the objectivity and independence of government statistics’ and ‘uphold the quality of government statistics’.

candidates.title: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) / National Statistics system
candidates.publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan
candidates.description: Central authority for official statistics in Taiwan. Oversees the national statistical system, produces major economic and social statistics, maintains statistical standards and classifications, and coordinates BAS units across government.
candidates.notes: Institutional core node. Equivalent to Japan’s Statistics Bureau / MIC and Korea’s KOSTAT. Disseminates via National Statistics portal and related platforms.

candidates.title: Population and Housing Census / Population statistics
candidates.description: Periodic Population and Housing Census together with inter-censal population estimates and vital statistics. Provides the demographic baseline for labour, social and economic statistics.
candidates.notes: Core demographic series. Parallel to Japan and Korea census nodes.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
candidates.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index and related price statistics. Primary measure of inflation used in monetary policy, wage and social analysis.
candidates.notes: Standard core price node. Continuously cited in Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) policy and economic analysis.

candidates.title: Manpower Survey / Labour Force statistics
candidates.description: Monthly survey of labour force, employment, unemployment and labour-force participation. Principal source of official labour-market indicators.
candidates.notes: Core labour series. Parallel to Japan’s Labour Force Survey and Korea’s Economically Active Population Survey.

candidates.title: National Accounts (System of National Accounts)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts compiled according to SNA 2008 standards. Covers GDP by expenditure and by industry, national income, savings and related aggregates. Includes regular revisions and quinquennial benchmark revisions.
candidates.notes: Macroeconomic core. Parallel to Japan’s JSNA and Korea’s national accounts.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (CBC)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual Balance of Payments statistics covering current account, capital and financial account, and reserve assets. Taiwan typically records large current-account surpluses.
candidates.notes: Core external-sector series from the central bank. Continuously cited in external-vulnerability and exchange-rate analysis.

candidates.title: Industrial Production Index
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Economic Affairs / DGBAS-related sources
candidates.description: Monthly Industrial Production Index with detailed manufacturing breakdowns. Semiconductor and electronics-related components are especially closely watched given their weight in Taiwan’s industrial structure and exports.
candidates.notes: High-frequency activity indicator. Semiconductor and electronic-parts production is a defining feature of Taiwan’s industrial cycle and global supply-chain role.

candidates.title: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) — institutional role and statistical publications
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange reserves, and a wide range of monetary, financial and external statistics (BOP, money supply, interest rates, banking statistics, etc.).
candidates.notes: Institutional counterpart to BOJ and BOK. Produces the principal monetary and external statistics that complement DGBAS national accounts and price data.

candidates.title: Producer Price Index / Wholesale Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly producer / wholesale price indices measuring industrial and wholesale price movements. Complements the CPI in the price-statistics suite.
candidates.notes: Standard complementary price series to CPI.

candidates.title: Trade Statistics (Customs-based merchandise trade)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Finance / Customs Administration / related agencies
candidates.description: Monthly customs-based statistics on merchandise exports and imports by commodity and partner. Critical for tracking Taiwan’s export-oriented performance, especially in electronics and semiconductors.
candidates.notes: Core trade series that feeds BOP goods account and industrial-policy analysis. Semiconductor and ICT export shares are defining structural features.

candidates.title: National Statistics portal / statistical dissemination system
candidates.description: Central web dissemination platform for official statistics produced by DGBAS and coordinated agencies. Functional equivalent of e-Stat (Japan) and KOSIS (Korea).
candidates.notes: Infrastructure node that underpins discoverability and citation of the entire official statistical output.
